place_fields.summary: A multi-cascade waterfall on the Kodachadri trekking route in the Mookambika reserve forest, reached by a rocky forest trek and steeper scrambling through the cascades.

planning_attributes.description: Hidlumane Falls is a series of cascading waterfalls near Nittur at the base of Kodachadri in the Western Ghats.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: Individual cascades are reported at about 50–70 feet; sources differ on the number of cascades.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Approach from Nittur/Bellakka or the Kodachadri route; the final approach is on foot through forest and rocky terrain.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The falls lie in forested protected-area terrain; check current forest permissions and local access conditions before trekking.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The route involves steep, slippery and rocky sections. Monsoon conditions can make the rocks hazardous and leeches are common; use proper trekking footwear and avoid unsafe climbing near strong water flow.
planning_attributes.notes: A trekker-oriented stop that can be combined with the Kodachadri trek.

place_fields.summary: A locally listed hiking-area attraction in Shivamogga, Karnataka, near Bhadravati.

planning_attributes.description: Hulibande Falls is listed as a hiking area in Shivamogga, Karnataka.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The available listing places the falls in Shivamogga, with Bhadravati railway station identified as the nearest rail station.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Treat the site as a natural water feature and use caution around wet rocks and water.
planning_attributes.notes: Publicly available documentation is limited, so detailed trail and seasonal claims are intentionally omitted.

place_fields.summary: An offbeat waterfall in the Hosanagara forest belt near Yadur, reached through a forest approach and known locally as Talasi Abbi Falls/Yaduru Abbi Falls.

planning_attributes.description: Talasi Abbi Falls is a lightly documented waterfall in the Hosanagara area near Yadur, Shivamogga district.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Approach via Yadur from the Mastikatte–Thirthahalli road, then continue on foot from the local parking/road approach.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Forest authorities closed public access following a fatal incident and warned against unauthorised entry; current access must be checked locally before planning a visit.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Strong currents, slippery rocks and changing monsoon water levels present serious hazards. Do not enter closed/restricted areas or swim in unsafe conditions.
planning_attributes.notes: The site is remote and lightly documented; local guidance is advisable if access is legally permitted.
